svg.text: Reviews a loan agreement against a compliance rule set and returns an evidence-backed report. LangGraph orchestration · Gemini · Pydantic contracts
manages shared state · routes tasks · enforces dependencies · retries · failure paths · audit log
Splits the document into clause chunks
Loads + validates the YAML rule set.
Fallback IDs p1:b2 for unnumbered docs.
Checks every quote really exists in
Thresholds + derived LTV / tenor in code.
Judgment rules: Gemini, one batched call.
citation failures -> retry once with feedback
on failure -> skip to escalation (report still produced)
every node reads it and returns only the keys it changes · all values are Pydantic models
• Every term, rule result and risk cites p<page>:<clause>.
• Quotes are re-checked against the source in code.
• Invalid citations dropped; unsupported PASS downgraded.
• LLM output validated by schema; retry ≤2 with error feedback.
• 429: backoff; daily quota: fail fast. Agent down -> fallback.
• Run ends completed_with_errors, never crashes; report always written.
• Missing, unverified or low-confidence input never yields PASS.
• Conflicts (two effective dates) lower confidence + escalate.
• Thresholds live in the YAML policy, not in code.
